input.normalBalance: K*(-gap)=500=mass*10+480, so z stays constant and contact has no torque or plane event

equations.sliding: At |Kt*e|=mu*N and outward motion, eDot=0, pDot=v, m*vDot=F-sign(v)*mu*N
equations.unloading: At a sliding stop whose acceleration points inward, the spring unloads elastically; no stored-energy reset
equations.noYieldFreeCondition: abs(v0) <= mu*N/sqrt(m*Kt) for zero initial stretch and external force
equations.forcedUndampedStep: For e0=v0=0 and F below cap/2, f=F*(1-cos(sqrt(Kt/m)*t)) never yields; subcap static root e=F/Kt exists but no asymptotic settling without dissipation

scope: Exact continuous 1D constant-normal-load elastic-perfectly-plastic traction with physical point force at the foot COM. No rotation coupling, time-varying normal, unloading contact, tangential viscous damping, joint force, production solver imports, NFL calibration or readiness claim. Partition invariance is an exact-reference check, not a measured numerical convergence order.
